content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The retroactive authorization window is closed, and Meridian does not offer peer-to-peer review, so neither route is available. A CO-197 denial is on the table, making a formal appeal with the strong clinical documentation the only compliant action that can still seek primary-payer reimbursement. Resubmission would not cure the missing authorization, while patient or secondary billing is premature before appeal rights are pursued."}
